US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.

US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

partialDossier.whatHappened: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
knownFacts: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

knownFacts: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

partialDossier.whatHappened: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
knownFacts: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.

partialDossier.whatHappened: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
knownFacts: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude’s front-month contracts climbed on Wednesday on the risk of more fighting.
US Central Command (Centcom) said the strikes were against "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure".
Iraq's paramilitary Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), which is dominated by Iran-backed Shia militias, said at least 20 of its members had been killed in US-Saudi strikes on its bases.
It came hours after Centcom said Iran had launched missiles at US forces in the Middle East in an "attempted surprise attack", ending a lull in hostilities.
The IRGC said it had targeted a US air base and a command centre in Jordan "in response to the acts of aggression of the American child-killing army".

historicalContextEngine.suggestedContextParagraph: No historical context should be forced into the article unless later evidence shows it materially helps explain the event.
editorialGuardrails: History should explain, not distract.
Historical context must be clearly attributed when it involves specific prior events.
Distinguish allegations, charges, convictions, settlements, dismissals, and acquittals.
Do not imply past events prove current claims.
Do not include legally sensitive history unless it is material to the current event and accurately described.
Do not let historical context become the lead unless the current event is explicitly a continuation of prior events.
historicalContextEngine.writerDirective: Use historical reasoning only when it materially helps explain the current event. Current verified facts lead; history provides cause, context, pattern, institutional memory, or outcome-aware background only when scored relevant.
historicalContextEngine.rule: Historical Reasoning System produces understanding: cause, context, pattern, relationship evolution, historical DNA, and outcome learning. It does not return old articles merely because names match.

dossierBuilder.job: Collect, verify, classify, timeline, context, contradictions, known facts, unknown facts, then deliver a structured dossier to the Writer.

stages.name: Collect
stages.evidence: 1 source article collected for the event.

stages.name: Event Integrity
stages.evidence: Event coherence 100%; contamination 0%.

stages.name: Verify
stages.evidence: 0 primary sources, 0 official statements, 0 shared claims, 1 extracted fact.

stages.name: Classify
stages.evidence: 6 people, 0 organizations, 6 locations, 0 documents classified.

stages.name: Timeline
stages.evidence: 1 timeline item available.

stages.name: Context
stages.evidence: the international event, the actors involved, the official response, and the wider security or diplomatic context

stages.name: Contradictions
stages.evidence: No major source contradiction was detected from the available source set.

stages.name: Known Facts
stages.evidence: 1 known fact prepared for the Writer.

stages.name: Unknown Facts
stages.evidence: whether officials have released a complete public statement; the exact timing of the next confirmed step; whether the next official action points toward escalation, negotiation, or containment

stages.name: Deliver Dossier To Writer
stages.evidence: Writer should draft from factLedger.writingEligibleFactIds and writerInput.directWritingFacts first, then use verification/context facts only for support.

outputContract.knownFacts: Facts the Writer may state directly.
outputContract.factLedger: Claim-level fact IDs with source provenance, verification status, event ID, and writing eligibility.
outputContract.integrity: Integrity decides whether the event is safe to write at all.
outputContract.depthCapacity: Depth decides whether the event becomes a developing brief, standard article, or deep article.
outputContract.unknownFacts: Missing or unresolved facts the Writer must not invent.
outputContract.sourceSpecificClaims: Claims that should be attributed or qualified unless later confirmed by other sources.
outputContract.contradictions: Conflicting claims that should be explained, not hidden.
outputContract.timeline: Sequence of known developments used to keep the story coherent.

records.preventionLesson: A story with fewer than two clean facts or no full-depth source should be enriched by Collector/Dossier before Writer handoff; do not let it vanish or become weak prose.
records.rule: Dossier recovery records why a story did not enter writing, so Collector/Dossier subsystems can enrich or split the event without weakening the Editor.

lastBoundedRecoveryPhase.rule: Bounded dossier recovery promotes ready held dossiers and keeps insufficient records active without weakening article quality gates.
